info.title: LMS Service API
info.description:
REST surface exposed to clients by the LMS (Learning Management System)
service. Vocational training for artisans: catalogue, native + SCORM 1.2
authoring, entitlements, progress/sequencing, native assessments, and
LMS-owned completion certificates.

**Shared conventions** (identical to Orchestrator / CAP, defined locally
here since the specs aren't composed): SuccessEnvelope / ErrorEnvelope
(§19), cursor pagination (§19), Money as
`{ amountMinorUnits: string, currency: string }` (§21). List endpoints
put the array on `data` directly (`{ success, data: [...], meta? }`) —
never wrap as `data.items`.

**Not in this document, deliberately:**
- Authentication, Address (countries/states/LGAs), Storage, and
  Notifications live on Orchestrator — see `orchestrator-openapi.yaml`.
  LMS persists Orchestrator `assetId` values only (SCORM zip, media,
  certificate PDF). SCORM *playback* is served by LMS player URLs, not
  Cloudinary delivery URLs.
- Payment **processing** is Orchestrator `InitiatePayment` gRPC. LMS
  **prices** and exposes checkout (`POST /enrollments/{id}/checkout`).
- CAP recommendations are **gRPC** (`lms.v1.RecommendationsService`) —
  not public REST. On course completion LMS emits `lms.course.completed`
  (independent of CAP certificates).

**Personas:** multi-role on one Orchestrator account. Each persona
(learner / instructor / staff) must complete LMS onboarding before that
persona's surface is unlocked. Instructors are platform-invite only.
Staff capabilities are a superset of instructor capabilities (broader
scope). Course `owner` + co-instructors may edit; owner and platform
staff may publish.

tags.name: Me
tags.description: Current LMS user, personas, onboarding gates, capabilities.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: Per-persona draft → merge-patch → submit. Multiple personas allowed (unlike CAP). Country/state/LGA values come from Orchestrator Address.

tags.name: Catalogue
tags.description: Authenticated browse of published courses. Item bodies remain entitlement-gated.

tags.name: Authoring
tags.description: Course / module / item CRUD, SCORM package attach (OL assetId), sequencing, publish.

tags.name: Instructors
tags.description: Platform-only instructor invites; course owner / co-instructor assignments.

tags.name: Enrollments
tags.description: Enrollment + entitlement + LMS-priced checkout (OL processes payment).

tags.name: Player
tags.description: Progress, sequencing locks, native launch, SCORM runtime session + CMI.

tags.name: Assessments
tags.description: Native quizzes/attempts (SCORM-internal quizzes are opaque CMI only).

tags.name: Certificates
tags.description: LMS completion certificates — independent of CAP RPL/NSQ certificates.

tags.name: Staff
tags.description: Staff invites, roles, admin grants, cross-course admin lists.

get.summary: Current LMS user, personas, onboarding status, and capabilities

200.description: Session identity in LMS (provisioned via user.created or first authenticated hit).

404.description: No lms_users row yet (should be rare — provision on user.created or lazily).

post.summary: Start onboarding for a persona (idempotent — resumes an existing draft)
post.description: Unlike CAP, starting a second persona is allowed. Instructor/staff start still requires a matching accepted invite (or bootstrap admin).

403.description: Instructor/staff onboarding without a valid invite (error.code lms.invite.required).

409.description: This persona's onboarding is already completed (error.code lms.onboarding.already_completed).

get.summary: All onboarding records for this account (one per persona started)
Full onboarding payload for the given persona

patch.summary: Save onboarding progress — merge-patch, not full overwrite

post.summary: Complete onboarding for this persona (unlocks that persona's app surface)

422.description: Required fields missing for this persona + schemaVersion.

get.summary: Browse published courses
Published course detail (metadata + price; not item bodies)

200.description: Course detail. 404 if unpublished (unless actor is instructor/staff with scope).

get.summary: Module/item outline (titles, order, types). Bodies remain entitlement-gated.

200.description: Outline. If enrolled, includes lock/completion hints per item.

get.summary: Courses the actor may author (assigned instructor, or all if staff)

post.summary: Create a draft course (caller becomes owner)

403.description: Not an instructor/staff, or onboarding incomplete.

get.summary: Full authoring payload including unpublished content

patch.summary: Update course metadata, price, CAP linkage, completion policy

post.summary: Publish course — owner or platform staff only (co-instructor cannot)
Unpublish course — owner or platform staff

patch.summary: Update module title, order, optional flag

post.summary: Add an item (native lesson/video/quiz/assignment or SCORM package)
post.description: For `scorm_package`, client first uploads the zip via Orchestrator `/storage/upload-url` (purpose `lms_scorm_package`) and passes `packageAssetId`. LMS validates imsmanifest.xml server-side and extracts for player hosting. Native media uses other OL assetIds.

422.description: Invalid SCORM package or item payload (lms.scorm.invalid_package).

patch.summary: Update item (body, quiz definition, SCORM asset, order, required flag)

put.summary: Replace module/item prerequisite graph (LMS-owned order, not SCORM 2004 sequencing)

get.summary: List instructor invites (platform staff)

post.summary: Invite an instructor by email (platform staff only)

409.description: Pending invite or existing instructor for this email.

get.summary: List owner and co-instructors

409.description: User already assigned or not an instructor.

delete.summary: Remove a co-instructor (cannot remove the sole owner)

get.summary: Learner's enrollments

post.summary: Start enrollment (pending if paid; active if already entitled or zero-price)
post.description: Requires completed learner onboarding. If an active entitlement already exists, enrollment activates immediately. If price is zero, entitlement source `self_pay` with amount 0 is recorded and OL is not called. Otherwise status stays `pending` until checkout + payment.completed.

get.summary: Enrollment + entitlement + progress summary

200.description: Enrollment (own learner, assigned instructor, or staff).

post.summary: Initiate payment. LMS prices; Orchestrator processes (gRPC InitiatePayment)
post.description: Client never supplies amount. referenceType is `lms_enrollment`, referenceId is the enrollment id. Result arrives asynchronously via payment.completed → entitlement + enrollment activate.

409.description: Already paid, zero-price, or pending checkout exists.

post.description: Creates/activates entitlement + enrollment without learner checkout. `sponsor` is "someone paid" (optional sponsorUserId / note). Organizations are out of LMS v1 (later on Orchestrator).

201.description: Entitlement active; enrollment activated; lms.enrollment.activated emitted.

409.description: Active entitlement already exists for this learner+course.

get.summary: Course progress rollup (percent, item statuses, locks)

post.summary: Launch an item (native body URL or SCORM player session)
post.description: Requires active entitlement. Sequenced items that are locked return 409 with error.code `lms.sequencing.locked`. SCORM launchUrl is an LMS player URL (extracted package), not a Cloudinary URL.

403.description: No active entitlement (lms.entitlement.required) or out of scope.

post.summary: Record native item progress (not used for SCORM — use CMI commit)

200.description: Item + course progress after rollup. May emit lms.course.completed.

409.description: Sequencing lock or enrollment not active.

get.summary: SCORM runtime session metadata (launch base + SCO href)

post.summary: Commit a SCORM 1.2 CMI snapshot (simplified runtime)

200.description: CMI stored; item progress rolled up.

get.summary: Native quiz definition for the learner (answers omitted)

409.description: Max attempts reached or sequencing lock.

get.summary: Get an attempt (score visible after submit)

post.summary: Submit answers; grade; roll up progress (may complete course)

get.summary: Learner's LMS certificates (not CAP certificates)
Certificate detail + storage asset (resolve URL via OL)
Certificate for a completed enrollment, if issued
List staff invites (admin)

409.description: Pending invite or existing staff for this email.

get.summary: List staff memberships (admin)
Cross-course enrollments (staff; instructors scoped to their courses)

ValidationError.description: Request shape or business-rule validation failed.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist, or does not exist from this actor's point of view.

OutOfScope.description: Layer 2 — role could attempt this action type, but this instance is outside the actor's scope. error.code is `auth.out_of_scope`.

Money.description: Minor units as a string + ISO 4217 currency — mirrors @yourorg/common Money.

CourseStatus.description: String + CHECK, not a DB enum.

EntitlementSource.description: Why the learner may access. v1 closed set; organization_seat later when orgs live on Orchestrator.

ResidentialAddress.description: country / state / lga must match Orchestrator Address reference data.

CapLinkage.description: Optional catalogue link for CAP gap-training recommendations.

prerequisites.description: Target cannot start until all `requires` ids are completed (module or item ids).

correct.description: Authoring only — omitted on learner paper.

packageAssetId.description: Orchestrator storage assetId of the SCORM 1.2 zip.

launchUrl.description: Native content URL or LMS SCORM player URL.

assetId.description: Orchestrator storage assetId for the PDF/image.
